moments.title: £2m Funding for Exeter Homelessness
moments.blurb: Exeter is set to receive almost £2 million in government funding to tackle rough sleeping and help people into accommodation.

angles.name: Exeter Support
angles.copy: Great news for Exeter! The city is getting nearly £2 million in government money to help tackle rough sleeping and support those experiencing homelessness.

angles.copy: This new £2 million funding for Exeter aims to provide settled homes and wraparound support for people facing long-term homelessness. A vital step for our community.
